# Requirements

A tiny feature used to test the spec engine.

## Requirement 1: Parsing

**User Story:** As a developer, I want kvx files parsed so that specs are data.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a kvx file is read THE parser SHALL preserve section order.
2. WHEN a key repeats THE parser SHALL keep the last value.

## Requirement 2: Rendering

**User Story:** As a developer, I want markdown mirrors so that humans can read specs.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN rendering runs THE output SHALL be byte-stable.
2. WHEN sources change THE check mode SHALL exit non-zero.
